structure_analysis.assembly_pattern: Release notes assembly with versioned module includes
observations: Assembly follows standard release notes pattern with separate modules for each patch version
All release note modules are REFERENCE type containing feature lists, breaking changes, known issues, and fixes
Single compatibility matrix module provides cross-version reference
Leveloffset +1 consistently applied to all module includes
Structure supports incremental updates as new patch versions are released
